{{nihongo|'''Oio Shrine'''|老尾神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shimōsa Province]].

'''Oio Shrine''' (おいおじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Oio, {{ill|Sōsa District, Chiba|fr|District de Sōsa|ja|匝瑳郡|ko|소사군|qid=Q7667621}}, {{ill|Shimōsa Province|ckb|پارێزگای شیمۆسا|cs|Provincie Šimósa|de|Provinz Shimousa|es|Provincia de Shimōsa|fa|ولایت شیموسا|fr|Province de Shimōsa|gl|Provincia de Shimōsa|hak|Shimōsa-koet|id|Provinsi Shimousa|it|Shimōsa|ja|下総国|ko|시모사국|lt|Šimosos žemė|nl|Shimosa (provincie)|pt|Província de Shimōsa|ru|Симоса (провинция)|simple|Shimōsa Province|sk|Šimósa|sr|Провинција Шимоса|tr|Shimōsa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сімоса|zh|下總國|zh_min_nan|Simôsa-kok|zh_yue|下總國|qid=Q1053695}} (present-day {{ill|Sōsa|Q858367|qid=Q858367}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|Q80011|qid=Q80011}}). It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} (small shrine), and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The main deity is {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Asahiko-no-Mikoto}}, child deity of {{ill|Futsunushi|fr|Futsunushi|it|Futsunushi|ja|経津主神|mni|ꯐꯨꯠꯁꯨꯅꯨꯁꯤ|pl|Futsunushi|ru|Фуцунуси|zh|經津主神|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi-no-Mikoto}}, deity of {{ill|Katori Jingū|abstract|Q372380|de|Katori-jingū|fi|Katori-jingū|fr|Katori-jingū|ja|香取神宮|la|Katori Templum|ro|Katori (sanctuar)|zh|香取神宮|qid=Q372380}}. Also enshrined are {{ill|Iwa-tsutsu-no'o|es|Iwatsutsunoo|ja|イワツツノオ|zh|石筒之男神|qid=Q9010200|lt=Iwatsutsuno-o-no-Mikoto and Iwatsutsuno-me-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Kuni-no-Tokotachi|ca|Kunitokotatchi|es|Kunitokotachi|fr|Kunitokotachi|it|Kuni-no-Tokotachi|ja|国之常立神|mni|ꯀꯨꯅꯤ-ꯅꯣ-ꯇꯣꯀꯣꯇꯆꯤ|ru|Куни-но токотати-но микото|simple|Kuni-no-Tokotachi|th|คูนิ โนะ โทโกตาจิ|uk|Куні но токотаті но камі|zh|國常立尊|qid=Q478504|lt=Kunitokotachi-no-Mikoto}}. There is also a theory that {{ill|Mononobe no Kogoto|ja|物部小事|qid=Q11570689}} is enshrined.

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, it was founded in year 7 of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|Q333530|qid=Q333530}}. It is listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} as “Oio Shrine, {{ill|Sōsa District, Chiba|fr|District de Sōsa|ja|匝瑳郡|ko|소사군|qid=Q7667621}}, {{ill|Shimōsa Province|ckb|پارێزگای شیمۆسا|cs|Provincie Šimósa|de|Provinz Shimousa|es|Provincia de Shimōsa|fa|ولایت شیموسا|fr|Province de Shimōsa|gl|Provincia de Shimōsa|hak|Shimōsa-koet|id|Provinsi Shimousa|it|Shimōsa|ja|下総国|ko|시모사국|lt|Šimosos žemė|nl|Shimosa (provincie)|pt|Província de Shimōsa|ru|Симоса (провинция)|simple|Shimōsa Province|sk|Šimósa|sr|Провинција Шимоса|tr|Shimōsa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сімоса|zh|下總國|zh_min_nan|Simôsa-kok|zh_yue|下總國|qid=Q1053695}},” and ranked as a small shrine. Within {{ill|Shimōsa Province|ckb|پارێزگای شیمۆسا|cs|Provincie Šimósa|de|Provinz Shimousa|es|Provincia de Shimōsa|fa|ولایت شیموسا|fr|Province de Shimōsa|gl|Provincia de Shimōsa|hak|Shimōsa-koet|id|Provinsi Shimousa|it|Shimōsa|ja|下総国|ko|시모사국|lt|Šimosos žemė|nl|Shimosa (provincie)|pt|Província de Shimōsa|ru|Симоса (провинция)|simple|Shimōsa Province|sk|Šimósa|sr|Провинција Шимоса|tr|Shimōsa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сімоса|zh|下總國|zh_min_nan|Simôsa-kok|zh_yue|下總國|qid=Q1053695}}, the only {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} in the territory of the {{ill|Shimotsu Unakami no Kuni Miyatsuko|ja|下海上国造|qid=Q11361123}} besides this shrine was {{ill|Katori Jingū|abstract|Q372380|de|Katori-jingū|fi|Katori-jingū|fr|Katori-jingū|ja|香取神宮|la|Katori Templum|ro|Katori (sanctuar)|zh|香取神宮|qid=Q372380}}, and this shrine was treated as the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sōsha}} of Sōsa District in Shimōsa.

The district where the shrine is located, {{ill|Sōsa District, Chiba|fr|District de Sōsa|ja|匝瑳郡|ko|소사군|qid=Q7667621}}, is said to have been established due to the military merits of {{ill|Mononobe no Kogoto|ja|物部小事|qid=Q11570689}} in subduing the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Bandō}} region; traditions also convey deep ties with the {{ill|Mononobe clan|Q1755836|qid=Q1755836}}, including three generations of the {{ill|Mononobe no Sōsa clan|ja|匝瑳氏|qid=Q24864171|lt=Mononobe no Sōsa clan}} - {{ill|Ashitsugi|ja|物部匝瑳足継|qid=Q11570688|lt=Ashitsugi}}, {{ill|Kuma-i|Q11570687|qid=Q11570687|lt=Kuma-i}}, and Suemori - serving as commanders guarding the region, together with {{ill|Shida district|Q11386034|qid=Q11386034}} in {{ill|Hitachi Province|cs|Provincie Hitači|de|Provinz Hitachi|es|Provincia de Hitachi|fa|ولایت هیتاچی|fr|Province de Hitachi|gl|Provincia de Hitachi|hak|Hitachi-koet|id|Provinsi Hitachi|it|Hitachi (provincia)|ja|常陸国|ko|히타치국|lt|Hitačio žemė|nl|Hitachi (provincie)|pt|Província de Hitachi|ru|Хитати (провинция)|simple|Hitachi Province|sk|Hitači (provincia)|sr|Провинција Хитачи|tr|Hitachi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Хітаті|zh|常陸國|zh_min_nan|Hitati-kok|zh_yue|常陸國|qid=Q1055353}}. Also, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sōsa Shrine}} exists as a {{ill|Sessha|Q135009904|qid=Q135009904}} of {{ill|Katori Jingū|abstract|Q372380|de|Katori-jingū|fi|Katori-jingū|fr|Katori-jingū|ja|香取神宮|la|Katori Templum|ro|Katori (sanctuar)|zh|香取神宮|qid=Q372380}}, and rebuilding this {{ill|Setsumatsusha|Q1071160|qid=Q1071160|lt=sessha}} is said to have formerly been a duty of Sōsa District. Furthermore, this shrine’s priestly family was the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Katori clan}}, and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Katori no Muraji Ioshima}}, who was granted {{ill|gei|Q11430321|qid=Q11430321|lt=external}} {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} for contributions of private grain to the garrison in {{ill|Mutsu Province|ca|Província de Mutsu|cs|Provincie Mucu|de|Provinz Mutsu|es|Provincia de Mutsu|fa|ولایت موتسو|fi|Mutsun provinssi|fr|Province de Mutsu|gl|Provincia de Mutsu|id|Provinsi Mutsu|it|Mutsu (provincia)|ja|陸奥国|ko|무쓰국|lt|Mucu žemė|nl|Mutsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Mutsu|ru|Муцу (провинция)|simple|Mutsu Province|sk|Mucu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Муцу|tr|Mutsu (vilayet)|uk|Муцу (провінція)|zh|陸奧國|zh_classical|陸奧國|zh_min_nan|Mutu-kok|zh_yue|陸奧國|qid=Q907389}}, is said either to have lived in Sōsa District or to have retired there after stepping down as {{ill|Negi|Q11594490|qid=Q11594490|lt=chief negi}} in old age. These traditions show ties with {{ill|Katori Jingū|abstract|Q372380|de|Katori-jingū|fi|Katori-jingū|fr|Katori-jingū|ja|香取神宮|la|Katori Templum|ro|Katori (sanctuar)|zh|香取神宮|qid=Q372380}}, and ties between Katori Jingū and the {{ill|Mononobe clan|Q1755836|qid=Q1755836}} are also discussed<ref>Kenichi Tanigawa, ''Nihon no Kamigami: Jinja to Seichi 11'', Hakusuisha, 2000, ISBN 4-560-02511-8, pp.265-267</ref>.

In {{ill|Shōhei|Q1143587|qid=Q1143587|lt=Shōhei}} 24 ({{ill|1369|Q6211|qid=Q6211}}), the shrine buildings were burned down and rebuilt by the {{ill|Chiba clan|Q2975237|qid=Q2975237}}. Thereafter, it was protected by the Chiba clan, but declined along with that clan’s weakening.

In October {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Precincts ===
Behind the shrine buildings on the left is a sacred cedar designated by the city as a {{ill|Natural monument|Q23790|qid=Q23790}}.

=== Access ===
* {{ill|East Japan Railway Company|Q499071|qid=Q499071}} / {{ill|Sōbu Main Line|Q1191364|qid=Q1191364}}, get off at {{ill|Yōkaichiba Station|Q5363766|qid=Q5363766}}, then 25 minutes on foot.
